label: TikTok
description: Connect your TikTok Pixel. In TikTok Ads Manager open Tools → Events → your Pixel: the Pixel code is at the top, and Settings → Generate Access Token gives the token. For the best match, the storefront also hands TikTok's click id to the app: see "Storefront integration" in the app guide at developers.swell.is/app-guides/tiktok-ads.

fields.label: Test event code
fields.description: Optional. While set, purchases go to the Pixel's Test Events tab only. Clear it when you are done checking.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.hint: Checks the saved Pixel code and access token with TikTok

fields.label: Send purchases to TikTok
fields.description: While this is on, every order placed through your storefront is sent to TikTok as a Purchase.
